description: Real-time positions of active vehicles for an agency. Optionally filter to a single route (client-side). Returns GPS coordinates, counter-clockwise orientation from east, schedule deviation, and current trip. Reports agency records omitted for missing position coordinates. Use agencyId values from onebusaway_list_agencies.

agencyId.description: Agency ID (e.g. "1" for Metro Transit, "40" for Sound Transit). Use onebusaway_list_agencies to discover IDs.

routeId.description: Optional agency-prefixed route ID to filter results to one route. Filtering is client-side — all agency vehicles are fetched first.

name: onebusaway_get_vehicles

count.description: Number of vehicles returned after any route filter.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `agency_not_found`: Agency ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitExceeded.description: True if the upstream capped the vehicle list — some vehicles were omitted. This endpoint has no pagination to retrieve them.

notice.description: Independent notices for records omitted without position, upstream truncation, and an empty returned list.

omittedWithoutPosition.description: Agency-wide records omitted because latitude or longitude is missing, counted before route filtering.

omittedWithoutPositionOnRoute.description: Omitted records whose canonical current trip resolves to the requested route; present only with a route filter.

routeId.description: Route ID filter applied client-side, if any.

timezone.description: Validated timezone of the requested agency, or UTC when unavailable or invalid.

vehicles.description: Active vehicles for the agency, optionally filtered by route.

lastUpdateTime.description: Timestamp of the last position update as Unix milliseconds.

nextStop.description: Stop ID of the next stop, or null.

orientation.description: Counter-clockwise degrees from east (0=east, 90=north, 180=west, 270=south), not a compass bearing; null if unavailable.

predicted.description: True if this vehicle is reporting real-time GPS data.

scheduleDeviation.description: Seconds late (positive) or early (negative), or null.

tripId.description: Active trip ID, falling back to the vehicle trip ID when absent; null if neither is available. All trip metadata resolves only from this ID.

title: Get Real-Time Vehicle Positions
